title.original: TopoCurate:Modeling Interaction Topology for Tool-Use Agent Training
title.zh: TopoCurate：工具使用代理训练的交互拓扑建模
title.en: TopoCurate:Modeling Interaction Topology for Tool-Use Agent Training

inclusion_reason.zh: TopoCurate 将多次工具交互压缩为可计算拓扑，并输出 SFT/RL 选择信号，是可插入训练栈的数据治理组件。
inclusion_reason.en: TopoCurate turns repeated tool interactions into a computable topology and emits SFT/RL selection signals as a reusable training-stack curation component.

abstract.zh: TopoCurate 将同一工具任务的多次 rollout 投影为交互拓扑，据此选择具恢复性和策略多样性的 SFT 轨迹及信息量更高的 RL 任务。
abstract.en: TopoCurate projects repeated rollouts of a tool task into an interaction topology, selecting recovery-rich, diverse SFT trajectories and structurally informative RL tasks.

problem.zh: 仅按成功与通过率筛选会保留冗余轨迹、忽略错误恢复，并把结构丰富任务和简单任务视为同等训练信号。
problem.en: Outcome-only filtering retains redundant trajectories, overlooks error recovery, and treats structurally rich tasks as equivalent to trivial ones.

approach.zh: 方法把语义等价的动作—观察状态合并成商拓扑，再用恢复、效率、策略多样性、错误分支和异质性指标进行双通道筛选。
approach.en: Semantically equivalent action-observation states are merged into a quotient topology, then recovery, efficiency, diversity, error branching, and heterogeneity drive dual selection.

system_design.zh: 系统先收集每任务多次轨迹，构建统一状态图与分支统计，再分别输出 SFT 轨迹队列和高信噪比 RL 任务队列。
system_design.en: The system gathers multiple trials per task, builds a unified state graph with branch statistics, and emits separate SFT-trajectory and high-signal RL-task queues.

key_results.zh: 交互感知选择在工具调用基准上同时改善 SFT 与 RL，说明结构信息可缓解模式坍缩和稀疏奖励下的弱梯度。
key_results.en: Interaction-aware selection improves both SFT and RL on tool-use benchmarks, indicating that structure can reduce mode collapse and weak gradients under sparse rewards.

limitations.zh: 拓扑质量依赖语义等价判断，多次 rollout 和图构建增加前置成本；当前证据只覆盖少数工具基准。
limitations.en: Topology quality depends on semantic-equivalence judgments, multi-trial graph construction adds cost, and evidence currently covers only a small set of tool benchmarks.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
